feature: Change Control add-on gate (#4452, Feature #1486) — when the calling tenant holds no active `change_control` row in tenant_add_on_entitlements, GET /api/portal/change-control answers 402 ADD_ON_REQUIRED (requireAddOnEntitlement, artifacts/api-server/src/lib/portal-addon-entitlements.ts). artifacts/portal/src/pages/change-control.tsx must render that as its own 'add-on not active' state — not the 'Couldn't load the change register' failure card, and never with the header claiming 'change control add-on active' (which it previously printed unconditionally). Companion to test-manifests/portal/change-control.json, which covers the ENTITLED path.
notes: RESOLVED #4488 2026-09-17: scripts/db/reset-rbac-test-accounts.mjs now creates its own dedicated, always-un-entitled tenant/account pair for this manifest — a stable synthetic tenant (tenant_id marker `zz-test-4488-nonpremier-tenant`, created/reused idempotently by the script itself, never touched by any real purchase flow) bound to a new 'Customer' rung, tag `customer-addongate` (email shanemccaw+customer-addongate@outlook.com). The script now aborts the whole run if that tenant ever picks up a real active monitoring_tier client_services row, rather than silently creating a 'non-Premier' account that would actually resolve entitled.

Live-verified 2026-09-17 against commit 2f8c4fcd7 (real :8080 api-server, real local Postgres): after a real reset-rbac-test-accounts.mjs run, POST /api/auth/login as shanemccaw+customer-addongate@outlook.com succeeded (customerId in the JWT = the new synthetic tenant's id), and GET /api/portal/change-control with that token returned 402 {"code":"ADD_ON_REQUIRED","feature":"change_control"} — exactly what G1 below expects. The same-run shanemccaw+customer@outlook.com (bound to the real Premier mccawsoft2 tenant) still returned 200 scoped:true on the same endpoint, confirming the two accounts now genuinely diverge on entitlement, as change-control.json (entitled) and this manifest (gated) each need.

SHANE TO-DO: apiTests below resolve credentials automatically via TestEnvironmentVariables (TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_ADDONGATE_EMAIL/_PASSWORD), which BuildConsole's 'Reset RBAC test accounts' gate writes on every real reset — no manual step needed for the apiTests. The top-level `loginAs` used by uiSteps is a DIFFERENT, manually-maintained list (Settings -> Test Environment -> User Accounts): add a new profile labeled exactly 'Customer — RBAC test (non-Premier add-on gate)', TargetApp 'Portal', pointing at shanemccaw+customer-addongate@outlook.com with its current TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_ADDONGATE_PASSWORD value, before the uiSteps below can run end-to-end.

Live-verified in-session (#4452) against the real :8080 api-server and a worktree portal Vite, driven by playwright-core/Edge as a synthetic zz-test-4452 Customer on a synthetic tenant (both deleted afterwards): gated state rendered this manifest's exact strings with a single 402 request and no downstream change-control reads; after temporarily granting the entitlement the same page read 'Live · genuinely empty', header 'change control add-on active', and all five change-control reads answered 200.
The Raise-a-change dialog is opened but NOT submitted — POST /api/portal/change-control creates a real change request, and this suite does not write.

STALE HISTORY (#4464, kept for context): prior runs bound this manifest to the same shared shanemccaw+customer@outlook.com account change-control.json uses, which stopped working once that account's tenant became genuinely Premier-entitled (#4452's real purchase). Superseded by the dedicated customer-addongate account above.
